data.name: Charlaine
data.gender_notes: Charlaine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the French name Charles, meaning 'man, free man'. This name has been popular among Christians due to the biblical figure Charles, who was a saint and a king. The name Charlaine carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Charlaine usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of freedom and personal autonomy.
data.etymology: Charlaine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charlaine total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: כרליין
in_hebrew.meaning: חופשייה, נדיבה, אשה חזקה ובעלת עוצמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כרליין היא שם שמשמעותו חופשייה, נדיבה, אשה חזקה ובעלת עוצמה. השם נגזר מהמילה העברית 'חור' שפירושה חופשי, ומ'ליין' שפירושה אשה חזקה. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב בקרב הנוצרים ומשמש כסמל לחירות ולעוצמה נשית.

in_greek.name: Χαρλαίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Χαρλαίνη είναι ένα όνομα που σημαίνει ελεύθερη, γενναία, δυνατή γυναίκα. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'χαρ' που σημαίνει χαρά και 'λαίνη' που σημαίνει δυνατή. Το όνομα Χαρλαίνη ήταν γνωστό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και χρησιμοποιήθηκε ως σύμβολο της θηλυκής δύναμης και της ελευθερίας.

in_latin.name: Charlaine
in_latin.long_meaning: Charlaine est nomen quod significat liberata, generosa, mulier fortis. Nomen derivatur a latino 'carl' quod significat liber et 'laine' quod significat mulier fortis. Nomen Charlaine in usu est apud christianos et est symbolum libertatis et feminae potentiae.

in_english.name: Charlaine
in_english.meaning: Free woman, generous, strong and powerful
in_english.long_meaning: Charlaine is a Christian name that originated from the Hebrew and Greek roots, meaning free woman, generous, strong and powerful. The name is derived from the Hebrew word 'char' meaning free and the Greek suffix '-laine' indicating strength. Charlaine is not a direct biblical reference but symbolizes feminine strength and liberty, highly valued in Christian traditions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charlaine has seen significant usage in various Christian communities, particularly in the French and English speaking worlds. It is often associated with strength, courage, and freedom – qualities that would have resonated with devout Christians who believed in the power of faith and self-determination.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Charlaine is rich in spiritual meaning for Christians. It is derived from the name Charles, which has deep biblical roots. The name is reminiscent of St. Charlemagne, the great Frankish king who was crowned emperor by Pope Leo III in Rome and played a significant role in the spread of Christianity in Europe. The name Charlaine is a testament to the power of faith and the strength of character that has shaped Christian history. It is a name that inspires a sense of spiritual commitment and encourages those who bear it to live their lives in accordance with Christian values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charlaine: Grace-filled Dwelling or Graceful Strength of the Home. A name evoking the protective and nurturing qualities of a woman, filled with the grace of God.
